scope.later_note_semantic_review: Not exhaustive; 38 whole-corpus absent-Chinese-anchor candidates inspected, four early misattachments confirmed and remaining candidates principally legitimate alternative/source-error comparisons. Does not prove later notes correct.

root_cause.proven: Misassociated/contaminated metadata is already inside initial raw output records. Effective-output assembly preserves those fields under the correct source IDs. Frozen final assembly is not where these notes moved.
root_cause.strong_inference: Several wrong notes correspond to exactly the same zero-based position in the preceding batch; others have varied local offsets, refer to a baseline record omitted from the selection, or mix subjects. This supports stale/index-addressed note composition during generation, rather than a global record/ID shift.
root_cause.not_proven: The first-cohort per-batch generation commands/model-invocation transcripts are not retained in the inspected working directory or its audit ZIP. A shared translation prompt survives but does not reveal the construction of the faulty per-record note assignments. Therefore no exact code line causing the original misattachments can be identified; generation hallucination versus manually reused index keys cannot be separated conclusively.
root_cause.saved_helper_evidence: Later retained write helpers zip positional Ukrainian rows with input records and independently attach notes.get(i,[]), automatically assigning id=s[id]. They validate counts and Chinese-reference preservation in glosses, but do not bind notes to source identity. Their local notes initialization resets each call, so this is not evidence of automatic Python state leakage.
root_cause.record_id_or_gloss_shift: No assembly-time ID/gloss shift found in effective-to-frozen comparisons across all 119668 expansion entries. The 15 cases were directly compared semantically and their gloss topics are their own. Raw ID problems do exist separately in four early batches and were corrected in correction files; none is a reported note-mismatch batch.
root_cause.unknown_bound: Confirmed attachment contamination is in next10000, as late as batch097. A non-exhaustive later-cohort anchor screen cannot prove later notes clean, and later positional helpers retain the same class of risk.

repair_or_quarantine_proposal.preferred_safe_plan: Create a separate candidate with ID-keyed note dispositions. Quarantine every note without an explicit per-ID semantic review; leave the original note text and record snapshot in an immutable sidecar. Retain every original uncertainty flag and add note_alignment_pending. Restore only reviewed/reworded notes under their verified IDs.
repair_or_quarantine_proposal.minimum_known_scope: Quarantine the 15 confirmed misattachments and 3 direct false claims; review/rewrite 3 ambiguous preservation claims. This fixes known cases only and must not be presented as proving all remaining notes reliable.
repair_or_quarantine_proposal.cohort_bounded_option: A first-cohort remediation can cover all 167 effective notes with the accompanying full note-topic review, but its 146 no-clear-attachment-error outcomes do not validate every factual claim. It does not justify calling later cohorts clean.
repair_or_quarantine_proposal.full_corpus_scope: 2534 current notes total. If a fully defensible public clean-note claim is required before full per-ID review finishes, quarantine all not-yet-reviewed note text, including later cohorts, with all original uncertainty flags retained. Sources/glosses and raw audit files remain unchanged.
repair_or_quarantine_proposal.no_automatic_remapping: Even unique-topic targets require rewrite/semantic acceptance: some notes themselves contain unsupported claims. Mixed/ambiguous cases are quarantined, never guessed or offset-shifted.
new_candidate_checks: Original frozen files and archives hashes unchanged
All original uncertainty_flags retained per ID
No original has_known_uncertainty true becomes false
Quarantined texts absent from presented verified note field
Every restored note has explicit reviewed target ID and source hash
Coverage described as note-association review, not complete dictionary semantics

regression_recommendations.change: Require rows and notes keyed by stable source ID, with asserted headword, pinyin and source hash at creation. Reject ordinal-only notes dictionaries and unknown IDs. Never silently attach notes to s[id] by position.

Add note-identity records: note_id, record_id, source_sha256, source_anchor, kind, review_status. Check source anchors where asserted. Flag absent Chinese strings/proper names/formulas as review candidates, not automatic errors, because source-correction notes legitimately mention alternatives.

Add fixtures for all 15 misattachments, including same-index prior-batch reuse, variable offsets, mixed DINK/holiday content, a target outside selected input (一神論), and ambiguous double acetyl targets. Tests must reject cross-record association even when IDs, segment counts and reference tokens pass.

Separate review state from note-text presence. Preserve existing has_known_uncertainty and uncertainty_flags by monotone union when notes are quarantined. Current bool(notes) recomputation would silently lose flags after clearing text.

Keep raw immutable. Apply any note repair through an ID-keyed reviewed patch containing before/after hashes, exact original text, disposition and reviewer rationale; regenerate a new candidate only. Preserve archived original notes and audit ZIPs.

Review every note for subject alignment and claim consistency, including notes without Chinese tokens. Require explicit note-review coverage, not complex-gloss samples or structural pass status, before asserting metadata is clean.
Flag correction as affecting the already-published baseline too; all 85596 baseline records are inherited unchanged. Do not describe it as only a final expansion defect.

Permute source/translation ordering and repartition batches while preserving IDs. ID-keyed notes must remain on their target. Assert deterministic rerun equality, no original uncertainty flag loss, preservation of raw hashes, and zero unsupported restored notes.

limits: No public state or dictionary artifacts changed.
No surviving first-cohort generation script reproduces the initial error; exact trigger cannot be proven.
An ID/count/hash/reference-token pass is structural provenance only, not semantic quality.
On-topic notes can contain factual or wording errors.
Unique-topic association is not automatic approval to transplant note text.

validator_negative_control.explanation: Only copied effective output plus input was validated in isolated audit directory. Originals untouched. Ten affected batches and their 1000 records pass the current structural/reference-token validator despite all 15 known contaminated notes.
